neighbours.label: attributing a claim to a vague or written source: 'read somewhere / someplace that', 'on some website', 'the authors wrote that', 'books have been written'
fire: I remember reading somewhere that octopuses have three hearts.
My aunt heard someplace that the old mill is going to be sold.
He found the recipe on some website years ago and still uses it.
The authors also noted in the article that sleep improved after treatment.
Entire books have been written about the fall of that empire.
I think Darwin wrote somewhere that patience was his only real talent.
According to several websites, the trail is closed in winter.
She had seen it claimed in some article that coffee stunts growth.
quiet: I remember hiding somewhere in the attic when the guests arrived.
My aunt lives someplace near the old mill by the river.
He found the wallet under some bench years ago and still keeps it.
The doctors also noticed in the clinic that sleep improved after treatment.
Entire cities have been built around the ruins of that empire.
I think Darwin sailed somewhere near the islands before turning home.
According to several hikers, the trail is closed in winter.
She had seen it happen in some village that frost ruined the harvest.

notes: Probes: 'read somewhere that' 0.54, 'on some website' 0.53, 'said someplace that' 0.48, 'authors also wrote that' 0.37; 'somewhere in the kitchen' 0.02; 'Other sites report' 0.01 and 'In an earlier article' 0.08, so the source words alone are not enough.
